title: Compatible local scheme maps from an affine structure-algebra morphism
statement: Let $S,X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to S$ a morphism, and $g:Y\to S$ an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let $\alpha:g_*\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$ be a morphism of $\mathcal O_S$-algebra sheaves [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. For every affine open $U\subseteq S$ there exist maps $k_U:X_U=f^{-1}U\to Y$ such that $g\circ k_U=f\circ\iota_U$. For every pair of affine opens $U,V$, the maps agree on $X_U\times_X X_V$. On sections over $g^{-1}U$, the map induced by $k_U$ equals $\alpha_U$ followed by the canonical identification $\Gamma(X,f^{-1}U)\cong\Gamma(X_U,\mathcal O_{X_U})$. No affineness assumption is made on $X$ or on $U\cap V$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SA; Constructions, Lemma 01LT; local construction and overlap comparison in parts (i) and (iii) of the fully faithful argument

proof.text: For an affine open U of S, g inverse image U is affine by [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] to the component of the algebra morphism alpha on U, conjugated by the top-section isomorphisms, to get a morphism from f inverse image U into g inverse image U. Compatibility with the structure-algebra maps implies that its composite to U is the restricted f, by injectivity of the same correspondence for affine U. Compose with the open immersion to Y to get k_U. The adjunction gives the displayed section formula.

For affine V contained in affine U, the restriction of k_U and k_V followed by the inclusion to Y_U are maps into the affine Y_U. Naturality of alpha makes their global section maps equal, so they are equal by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme]. For arbitrary affine U,V, cover U intersection V by smaller affine W. On every inverse image of W the two maps on the overlap agree with k_W. Uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] gives equality on the overlap, which is the pullback of the open immersions. This works for empty opens and does not require the intersection or X to be affine.

Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms and ι_glueMorphisms construct global maps from a compatible family; ext_of_isAffine supplies uniqueness. No theorem constructs the compatible relative local family from an algebra morphism.
